name: Bassem Boules
heroLine: Fourteen years of drawing faces, light and the cities in between. Portraits, public art, risograph and digital painting, and more than 500 workshops taught.
intro: I'm an Egyptian artist, trained in the Faculty of Fine Arts at Alexandria University and based in Dubai. I draw the way the Old Masters taught: slowly, from light and shadow, until a face starts looking back. Then I teach it, to anyone willing to look a little longer.

skills.title: Portrait drawing
skills.text: Charcoal, graphite and soft pastel, built from proportion, light and shadow in the tradition of the Old Masters.

skills.title: Risograph printing
skills.text: Layered colour printing by hand, one ink at a time, from posters to editions of up to five colours.

skills.title: Digital art
skills.text: Painterly portraits and illustration in Procreate, with every brushstroke kept visible.

skills.title: Watercolour
skills.text: Light, transparent colour and loose washes, for painting and for teaching beginners to trust the water.

works.title: Eye Study I
works.story: Charcoal makes the eye come alive. One of a pair of studies built from soft charcoal, a blending stump and the white of the paper.

works.title: Idris Elba
works.story: Painted with a single oil flat brush with thick bristles, keeping every stroke visible in the beard and skin.

works.title: Wdn Al Ota
works.story: “The cat's ear”: the Egyptian nickname for molokhia leaves, because of their shape. A kitchen in Egypt, a bowl of soup and a cat who knows exactly what it wants.

works.title: Tear
works.story: A study of a single eye: wet lashes, a green-grey iris and one tear leaving a trail across the skin.

works.title: Between the Past and Future
works.story: A woman in a red kandora and gold-trimmed burqa reaches for an old lantern while the Dubai skyline waits, half drawn, behind her.

works.title: Eye Study II
works.story: The companion study: lashes drawn one by one, and the window light reflected in the iris.

works.title: Classic Soft Pastel Portrait
works.story: A large portrait built up by hand in layers of soft pastel.

works.title: Fairouz
works.story: The singer drawn in thousands of engraved lines of riso blue, overprinted with Ibrahim Zaki's red Arabic lettering. Shown in the group exhibition Khali Balak Men RISO, Dubai, 2026.

works.title: Eye Study
works.story: Each wrinkle and texture tells a story.

works.title: Eight Hours of Charcoal
works.story: A cat in eight hours of charcoal, finished fur by fur with a white pencil.

works.title: Mona Zaki
works.story: A portrait of the Egyptian actress, painted in four and a half hours.

works.title: A Day in Dubai
works.story: The Museum of the Future, Dubai Frame, Burj Al Arab and Burj Khalifa in one afternoon. Each colour is a separate pass through the riso machine; the print took about two hours.

works.title: Pencil Study
works.medium: Mechanical pencil, charcoal and soft powder
works.story: Drawn with a fine mechanical pencil over a charcoal and powder base.

works.title: Teaching Study
works.story: Painted live for a class, to show how the eye is built from shapes of warm and cool colour.

works.title: The Pantocrator
works.story: Christ as the Alpha and the Omega, in the tradition of Coptic icon painting.

items.title: Portrait commissions
items.text: Charcoal, pastel or digital paint, from a photograph you love. For gifts, families and memorials.

items.title: Public art & murals
items.text: Large-scale work for walls, lobbies, schools and public spaces, from sketch to finished wall.

items.title: Private instruction
items.text: One-to-one lessons in drawing, portrait, watercolour and digital art, at your pace and level.

items.title: Mentorship
items.text: Guidance for artists building a portfolio, a practice or a career in the arts.

items.title: Workshops for organisations
items.text: Hands-on sessions for schools, companies, museums and events: portrait, riso, watercolour and Procreate.

items.title: Illustration & design
items.text: Illustration, posters and print pieces for brands, books and cultural projects.

teaching.title: More than 500 workshops
teaching.text: I teach drawing, portraiture, watercolour, risograph and digital art to children, families, adults and teams. The method is the same at every level: look longer, measure honestly, and let light and shadow do the work.
